rationale: Root is needed to add a genuinely independent top-level program for the averaged/branchwise UV scalar, its tensorization, skew-symmetry reduction, and exact half-skew BSSC evaluation. The root frontier remains numerically unchanged but should record that the same value 2h₂(1/4)−5/4 is now independently accepted as a valid, non-improving UV-relaxed converse. The dependence-balance program and its counterfeit result may need scoped wording updates: attaining this value in the coarse entropy relaxation still supplies no capacity bound, but the current categorical phrasing should distinguish that fact from the newly accepted UV derivation of the same numerical upper bound. Existing posterior-support and auxiliary-receiver conclusions are unchanged.
